**PR: https://github.com/example-org/example-repo/pull/107**

Root cause: the custom `consumeWheelLines` handler registered with `capture: true` + `stopImmediatePropagation()` killed all wheel events before xterm.js could convert them to SGR mouse escape sequences for tmux. Fix: delete the handler entirely (−54 lines, +0 new runtime code). xterm.js handles this natively when tmux has `mouse on`.
